gate_9c_c.rule: Patient Maximum State (S_max) Reached During Labor

gate_9c_d.provenance: All 5 state thresholds (S_max <= 0.3, P < 2, P >= 2, N_t >= 2, S > 1.0) were defined a priori in Phase 9B based on clinical physiological hierarchy (FIGO / physiological severity) and were completely frozen before Phase 9C testing. No test fold outcomes were utilized for tuning.

threshold_specifications.State 0 (Stable): Maximum domain severity S_max <= 0.3 with no active worsening.
threshold_specifications.State 1 (Emerging): Transient single-domain abnormality (consecutive duration P < 2 windows).
threshold_specifications.State 2 (Persistent): Persistent single-domain abnormality (consecutive duration P >= 2 windows).
threshold_specifications.State 3 (Progressive): Multidomain concurrent worsening (N_t >= 2 domains actively abnormal).

features.name: baseline_bpm
features.clinical_rationale: Severe tachycardia (>160 bpm) and severe bradycardia (<110 bpm) indicate fetal compromise.

features.name: baseline_slope
features.clinical_rationale: Rapidly shifting baseline indicates autonomic instability.

features.name: stv_ms
features.clinical_rationale: Reduction in short-term variability is hallmark of fetal autonomic depression and acidemia.

features.name: ltv_bpm
features.clinical_rationale: Loss of long-term variability indicates uncompensated autonomic hypoxia.

features.name: var_slope
features.clinical_rationale: Progressive loss of variability over time signals acute deterioration.

features.name: accel_count
features.clinical_rationale: Absence of accelerations reflects non-reactive physiological state.

features.name: early_decel_count
features.clinical_rationale: Head compression decelerations; benign in isolation but indicative of labor stress.

features.name: late_decel_count
features.clinical_rationale: Uteroplacental insufficiency decelerations; strong marker of chemoreceptor hypoxia.

features.name: var_decel_count
features.clinical_rationale: Umbilical cord occlusion decelerations; baroreceptor mediated.

features.name: prolonged_decel_count
features.clinical_rationale: Decelerations lasting >3 minutes indicate acute asphyxial risk.

features.name: decel_max_depth_bpm
features.clinical_rationale: Deeper decelerations reflect greater parasympathetic surge / hypoxic depression.

features.name: decel_area_bpm_s
features.clinical_rationale: Total area reflects cumulative depth and duration of hypoxic burden.

features.name: decel_burden_pct
features.clinical_rationale: Percentage of monitoring window spent in deceleration state.

features.name: longest_decel_s
features.clinical_rationale: Prolonged single episodes pose highest risk of acute decompensation.

features.name: uc_count
features.clinical_rationale: Excessive contractions impede placental perfusion during recovery intervals.

features.name: uc_tachysystole
features.clinical_rationale: Direct clinical definition of uterine hyperstimulation.

features.name: mean_uc_amp
features.clinical_rationale: Higher intrauterine pressure increases uterine vessel compression.

features.name: fhruc_lag_s
features.clinical_rationale: Decelerations lagging behind contraction peaks define pathological late decelerations.

features.name: fhruc_coupling
features.clinical_rationale: Tight coupling between contractions and decelerations indicates repetitive placental compromise.
